what: K3D: the three-dimensional supervised transformer trained with the stiffness-norm loss beside the stored L_D and label-free states (PREREG_K3D)

config._comment: K3D: the three-dimensional supervised transformer of Phase-2 trained with the stiffness-norm loss L_K in place of L_D on its 1,024 labelled instances (Phase-2's settings and seeds, activation checkpointing off as in Phase-2's L_D units), evaluated beside Phase-2's L_D states and Phase-2b's label-free states, which are not trained again, on the validation split and on PREREG_HOLDOUT's h3d set with the labels its run computed; see PREREG_K3D.md
